regulatory_history.title: McDonald v. Kiloo ApS (N.D. Cal. No. 3:17-cv-04344-JD): class settlement with ironSource USA, Inc. approved
regulatory_history.body: US District Court for the Northern District of California
regulatory_history.notes: Final approval with no finding of wrongdoing; amended on 2021-08-16. For US devices, ironSource agreed to serve only contextual ads, without persistent identifiers or street-level location, in Subway Surfers and other children's apps, and to make developers certify whether apps are directed to children under 13.

procedural_note.text: On 2021-08-16 the court amended the order to correct a drafting error in the term on developers re-confirming their children's settings after SDK updates.
